name: Fir Domnann

attributes.attribute: another name for the Fir Bolg

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Fir Domnann is a tribal name in Irish myth. The term points to the Fir Bolg. For the full account of this people, see the entry on the Fir Bolg.

okr.objective: Fir Domnann is a cross-reference to the Fir Bolg.
